evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework owasp_llm_top10   # 10/10 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: All ten categories PASS by verified non-capability: the package imports no ML runtime (no torch, transformers, vllm, sentence-transformers) and contains no prompt, model or agent surface. A PASS means the risk is structurally absent, not mitigated.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework owasp_top10   # 9/9 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: All ten categories are mapped to an implemented control; each PASS asserts the mapped test exists and that the named non-capability (no listener, no egress) holds in source. It is not a penetration test.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework soc2   # 9/9 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: Trust Services Criteria are mapped to implemented controls and verified by execution. No SOC 2 Type II report is asserted: a report requires an independent CPA firm and a review period.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework nist_ai_rmf   # 8/8 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: GOVERN/MAP/MEASURE/MANAGE functions are mapped and verified. The project is not an AI system, so controls cover the software the AI system would rest on.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework nist_800_53   # 12/12 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: Selected control families are implemented and verified. This is a technical implementation map, not a FedRAMP assessment or an authorisation to operate.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework nist_csf   # 8/8 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: CSF 2.0 functions are covered through the aligned control map. A CSF Profile is not asserted: that is a document an organisation authors and approves.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework fedramp   # 10/10 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: Control implementations are verified in-repo. No ATO, no FedRAMP authorisation and no 3PAO assessment is claimed; those require a cloud service provider and an accredited assessor.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework pci_dss   # 11/11 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: Requirements 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, 10 and 11 are implemented and verified. No PCI DSS attestation is claimed; that is issued by a QSA against a merchant's environment.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework iso_27001   # 9/9 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: Annex A controls are implemented and verified. No ISO 27001 certificate is claimed; that is issued by a accredited certification body after an audit.

evidence.coverage_command: anticloud-ref bench --framework mitre_attack   # 12/12 controls have a present evidence file
evidence.scope_of_claim: Adversary techniques are mapped to the control that resists them, verified by execution. This is not adversary emulation or a purple-team exercise.
